positive.prompt: Execute this approved implementation plan in parallel by mapping dependencies and delegating independent modules to subagents
Split the approved plan into dependency waves and run its isolated file changes concurrently
Use subagents to complete the independent tasks in this approved plan faster, then integrate and verify their work

negative.prompt: Write a short dated change plan for this patch without code or an independent review
Critique and revise this unexecuted implementation plan before anyone writes code

evals.prompt: Execute an approved plan containing three independent module changes and one integration task. Dispatch every safe independent task concurrently, prevent conflicting writes, and verify the integrated result.
evals.expected_output: A dependency-wave execution record that dispatches all safe independent tasks with exclusive ownership, integrates their reviewed results, and verifies the final result.
expectations: The agent maps prerequisites and groups only independent tasks into concurrent waves
Every concurrent task has exclusive writable files or modules plus task-local context and verification
The main agent reviews results and completes integration before dependent work begins
The final report records waves, subagent outcomes, deviations, and verification evidence
